questions.question: Which of the given letter-number clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the following series to make it logically complete?MPJ19, NQK31, ORL43, PSM55, ?
In a certain code language, ‘DAYS’ is coded as ‘6958’ and ‘LADY’ is coded as ‘2958’. What is the code for ‘L’ in the given code language?

In a certain code language,'A + B' means ‘A is the son of B’,'A − B' means ‘A is the brother of B’,'A × B' means ‘A is the wife of B’ and'A ÷ B' means ‘A is the father of B’.Based on the above, how is D related to J if ‘D + F ÷ G × H − J’?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Brother's wife's brother) है।

questions.question: Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:  All mirrors are houses.Some kites are houses.Some figs are kites.Conclusions:(I) Some houses are figs.(II) Some kites are mirrors.1.0.9.15
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.) है।

Harsh starts from Point Y and drives 19 km towards north. He then takes a left turn, drives 22 km, turns left and drives 58 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 17 km. He takes a right turn, drives 13 km. He then turns right, drives 39 km to stop at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (26 km towards north) है।

She turns right again and drives 4 km. She then takes a final right turn and drives 2 km and stops at Point Q. How far (the shortest distance) and in which direction should she drive now in order to reach Point P again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (2 km towards the north) है।
